# Instructions for AI coding assistants (Copilot, etc.)

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) strictly. Essentials:
1. Read `docs/05-roadmap.md` and work on one task at a time.
2. Respect the hard rules and budgets in AGENTS.md §6.
3. Run the verification gate in AGENTS.md §5 before finishing.
4. Never present unverified behaviour as fact. Mark it 🔬 and probe it.
